data.name: Rending Claw Blades

Special Ability ~ Keen ~ Weapon.Special Ability ~ +1 ~ Weapon.Material ~ Steel

When making a full attack with claws, if the wielder hits the same target with this weapon and a different claw attack or set of claw blades, he deals an extra 1d4 damage plus 1-1/2 times his Strength bonus. The wearer can deal this extra damage no more than once per round.
